baseline_root_cause: Dropping the idx_ledger_account_entry_date index caused ledger balance queries to fall back to full table scans, saturating the DB connection pool and triggering cascading timeouts and pod failures
reasoning: The deployment at 14:04 applied migration 012_drop_legacy_ledger_index.sql which removed the idx_ledger_account_entry_date index. Immediately after, the log at 14:04:45 shows the SELECT on ledger_entries jumping to 1850 ms with a Seq Scan on 5 M rows. Metrics confirm the query duration spiking from ~4 ms to 1850 ms and client retries exploding, filling all 15 DB connections by 14:05:30. With the pool exhausted, health checks and API calls timed out (500/504 errors) and the readiness probe failed, leading Kubernetes to kill the pod and the ingress to return 502. Thus the single change (index drop) directly caused the performance degradation and the observed outage cascade.
